frame.prompt: Create exactly ONE native complete full-body 1024x1024 transparent PNG game character animation frame for 07 Moon Shadow Assassin Girl (Wuxing Qitan). Reference 1 is ORIGINAL IDENTITY, reference 2 is approved PRIMARY PAINTING STYLE ONLY (bright clean rounded detailed Chinese Daoist chibi illustration, no UI or background), reference 3 is this direction's approved NE rear-three-quarter idle proportion/equipment reference. Preserve identity and clothing: silver straight short bob and single curled ahoge, large purple eyes when front visible, navy three-lobed butterfly bow with gold-silver crescent ornament at her ANATOMICAL LEFT temple and dangling blue tassel, ivory sleeves, navy gold scroll-trimmed short martial tunic and scarf, short trailing navy scarf tail, loose navy trousers, navy gold crescent short boots, turquoise waist beads, silver crescent belt buckle, exactly TWO silver crescent daggers with gold guards/turquoise gems, one held in each hand. Both daggers held low safely away from legs, travel with arms. Keep same 2.5-head chibi body, soft round face, compact short limbs, exact costume shapes, high quality hand-painted shading. Do not add/remove gear; preserve left/right costume asymmetry in all directions. Fixed orthographic slightly elevated game camera, same camera height and lighting every frame. Full character fits with generous clear margin: on 1024 square hair top about y=90 and grounded foot baseline about y=930; pelvis centered x=512, stable body size. Genuinely transparent alpha background, clean antialiased silhouette without colored fringes, no ground shadow, no aura or dust or motion trails. No floor, text, borders, frame numbers, UI, grid, sheet, duplicate figures, painted checkerboard. Never crop hair, scarf, blades or shoes. DIRECTION: NORTHEAST (up-right screen, AWAY and RIGHT): back-right three-quarter view; primarily back of head and back/side of tunic, only a tiny right-facing cheek edge if visible, no two eyes; nose if any points upper-right. Torso, hips and feet all face NE. ACTION: actual walking-in-place cycle phase 9 of 16 at 30 milliseconds per frame. RIGHT heel contact: anatomical right leg extended forward a moderate walking stride, right heel just landed, left leg extended backward with left heel lifted and only left toe grounded. Left arm forward and right arm back. Natural alternating weight transfer; at least one foot grounded. Locomotion is along the stated facing direction. The legs move in depth for frontal/back views, along screen X in side views. Same bone lengths and torso shape; slight natural vertical bob only, no jumps, no skating, no crossover legs, no crouch or combat action. Independently draw this phase, preserve identity/proportions and anchor; do not duplicate or mirror another pose. REAR VIEW: show closed navy back tunic, back waist belt and boot heels. Front belt buckle, turquoise front bead strand, ivory front V opening and toe crescents are hidden behind the body. Head, chest, pelvis, knees and both toes all face NE away toward upper-right. Preserve the complete NE view of reference 3 while independently redrawing the walking leg and arm phase.
